results.title: Pattern Alignment Strudel
results.snippet: Pattern Alignment & Combination One core aspect of Strudel, inherited from Tidal, is the flexible way that patterns can be combined, irrespective of their structure. Its declarative approach means a live coder does not have to think about the details of how this is done, only what is to be done.
